title: SEISMIC WINDOW // FAULT SHEAR
historicalBasis: USGS ShakeMap Calibrated Mw 7.7 Seismic Rupture Event (Analog: Bhuj & Northridge fault shear studies). Calibrated using USGS Earthquake Hazards Program FDSN web feeds, instrumental ground acceleration ShakeMap records (PGA > 0.8g), and post-earthquake telecommunications network survivability analyses.
syntheticDisclaimer: Command entities, scenario injects, and tactical units are synthetic training constructs.

environment.weatherDescription: Magnitude 7.7 blind thrust fault slip; ground rupture displacement >3.5m, dense particulate dust cloud obscuring optical electro-optical drone sensors.

events.message: Routine baseline report: USAR Sierra staging complete; fiber trunk telemetry normal.

payload.content: USAR Sierra operational: Sector structural scans complete. 120 rescue personnel equipped with acoustic listening devices.

events.message: SEISMIC FAULT SHEAR: Mw 7.7 earthquake creates 3.8m horizontal ground offset. Metro subterranean fiber conduit severed instantly.
ATMOSPHERIC DUST INGRESS: Masonry collapse generates dense particulate cloud. Drone electro-optical cameras completely blinded.
USAR Sierra transmits urgent bridge collapse alert via COW mobile cellular link.

payload.content: CRITICAL ACCESS SEVERANCE: River arterial highway bridge center span collapsed into the gorge. Both concrete abutments sheared. Primary evacuation route completely impassable.

events.message: DANGEROUS CONTRADICTION: Civilian dispatch bulletin claims highway bridge is open with minor cracks, urging ambulance convoys to proceed.

payload.content: STALE BULLETIN: Municipal traffic dispatch broadcast claims bridge is structurally intact for light emergency traffic (dispatchers relying on 30-minute-old pre-quake status).

events.message: CELLULAR CONGESTION: Public network handover traffic overwhelms COW relay. Packet loss jumps to 28%.
Combat Engineer Detachment reports via low-band VHF tactical net.

payload.content: Engineers on VHF channel: Confirming bridge is collapsed. We have launched an armored bridging vehicle to establish a provisional 40-meter bridge crossing at south gravel ford.

events.message: Recon Drone activates Long-Wave Infrared (Thermal) sensor payload.

payload.content: FLIR thermal imaging penetration confirmed through dust cloud: Pinpointed 14 distinct human body-heat anomalies beneath collapsed municipal complex. Relaying GPS coordinates to Sierra.

decisionWindows.situation: Primary fiber has sheared at the fault plane. Optical drone cameras are blinded by masonry dust. A stale municipal dispatch is directing ambulances toward a collapsed bridge span, while USAR Sierra on the ground confirms the bridge is destroyed. You must switch communications to reliable VHF tactical transceivers, halt ambulances from crossing the ruined bridge, re-route via the engineer ford detour, and switch drone sensors to Thermal IR.
